high_level_description: The image depicts a woman standing in a library or bookstore, surrounded by bookshelves filled with various books. She is wearing a white, sleeveless, knee-length dress with a floral pattern. The woman has long, dark hair and is holding a book in her left hand while looking at another book she is holding in her right hand. Her expression appears to be one of concentration or curiosity as she examines the book. The books on the shelves behind her are arranged neatly, with titles and authors visible on the spines.
